# BiSpikCLM

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A binarized spiking language model architecture that integrates spiking attention and alignment distillation for efficient language processing on neuromorphic hardware. This represents a concrete architecture for deploying language models in resource-constrained in-network neuromorphic systems, enabling real-time, low-power NLP tasks.
